findings.current: I can’t even guarantee he’ll last another month or two.
findings.defect: Changes the physician’s estimate from roughly two months to a range beginning at one month.
findings.rationale: 두어 달 means roughly two months.
findings.replacement: I can’t even guarantee he’ll last another couple of months.
findings.source: 앞으로 두어 달은 더 버틸 수 있을지조차 장담할 수 없는 상황이지요.

findings.current: Even Blood Soul Gu can’t stand up to the Myriad-Poison Ring. It can definitely cure him.
findings.defect: Omits Taekyung’s initial qualification and his immediate correction to certainty.
findings.rationale: 충분한 가능성이. 아니 marks his shift from saying there is a good chance to insisting on a cure.
findings.replacement: Even against Blood Soul Gu, the Myriad-Poison Ring gives us a good chance. No—it can definitely cure him.
findings.source: 제아무리 혈혼고라고 해도 만독지환이면 충분한 가능성이. 아니, 확실히 치료할 수 있습니다.

findings.current: But for someone standing at death’s door, nothing is crueler than false hope.
findings.defect: Calls the hope false, although the notice warns against offering it prematurely.
findings.rationale: 섣부른 describes haste or prematurity, not a hope already known to be false.
findings.replacement: But for someone standing at death’s door, nothing is crueler than giving them hope too soon.
findings.source: 그러나 죽음을 앞둔 이에게는, 섣부른 희망보다 잔인한 것은 없습니다.

findings.current: Remove the Blood Soul Gu lodged in the Emperor’s mind and free him from the pain that has tormented him for so many years.
findings.defect: Places the physical poison in the Emperor’s mind rather than his head.
findings.rationale: 머릿속 specifies a physical location for the Blood Soul Gu.
findings.replacement: Remove the Blood Soul Gu lodged in the Emperor’s head and free him from the pain that has tormented him for so many years.
findings.source: 황제의 머릿속에 자리 잡은 혈혼고를 제거하여, 오랜 세월 그를 괴롭혀 왔던 고통에서 해방시키십시오.

findings.current: “Either way, you still have no way to treat them, right?”
findings.defect: Has Hyuk Mujin address Taekyung as the would-be healer before his later reaction reveals that connection.
findings.rationale: The Korean leaves the healer unstated; Mujin’s abrupt change of tone comes only after he sees Taekyung trembling.
findings.replacement: “Either way, that still means there’s no way to treat them, right?”
findings.source: 그래 봤자 결국은 치료할 방법이 없다는 거 아닙니까?

findings.current: “You got dumped by Miss Zhu, didn’t you?”
findings.defect: Uses a different rendering for the established address 소저.
findings.rationale: The supplied glossary specifies Young Lady for 소저.
findings.replacement: “You got dumped by Young Lady Zhu, didn’t you?”

findings.current: Then, his eyes still fixed on the pocket watch hanging from my neck, he asked,
findings.defect: Drops the wistful longing in Mujin’s look at the watch.
findings.rationale: 아직도 미련이 뚝뚝 묻어 나오는 눈 conveys that he still visibly longs for it.
findings.replacement: Then he looked wistfully at the pocket watch hanging from my neck and asked,
findings.source: 아직도 미련이 뚝뚝 묻어 나오는 눈으로 내 목에 걸린 회중시계를 바라보며 입을 열었다.

summary: Several lines change the prognosis, the Quest’s description of the poison, or the timing of Hyuk Mujin’s realization.
